images.prompt:
Use case: compositing / outpainting. Edit IMAGE 1, the 1536×1024 canvas. IMAGE 2 is solely the approved painted style and atmosphere reference; do not copy its layout or its terrain. Deliver one 1536×1024 PNG.
LOCKED REGION: preserve the existing leftmost 256 columns (x=0 through 255, all rows) of IMAGE 1 exactly as supplied, at their original positions, without repainting, recoloring, scaling, or shifting. Replace only the flat mid-grey placeholder at x=256 through 1535 with seamless continuous painting. Continue each cloud shape, color plane and haze band across x=256 so no join remains.
Scene: this is the RIGHT panel of a two-panel continuous SUNSET SKY parallax background, the farthest backdrop for a hand-painted 2D game. Sky fills the entire image. Blazing sunset illumination comes from the sun far offscreen to the LEFT in the neighboring panel; continue its long gold rays without adding another sun. Huge sculpted clouds in bold graphic shapes, saturated orange, hot magenta, violet and gold. A few dark cool-violet smoke plumes rise from below the image on the RIGHT and merge into the clouds, their bases hidden in a soft band of violet atmospheric haze near the bottom. NO land anywhere, including the bottom. No cliffs, cliff rims, horizon terrain, mountains, trees, buildings, ruins, valley, ground or water.
Style: hand-drawn painted 2D in the manner of modern hand-animated action game backgrounds. Confident hand-drawn tapered dark contours with varying weight, lighter and thinner in distant forms; painted fills in clean planes, restrained surface texture, bold jewel tones and graphic shapes, rich environmental detail. Match the existing painted left strip very closely. Cool violet low-value shadow planes with readable detail, orange and gold cloud edges lit from the left. No conspicuous grain. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette. This is an opaque full sky panel; fill all grey placeholder with sky. Preserve the entire painted overlap strip exactly.

references.role: edit target — painted left overlap and grey placeholder

concerns: Dimensions confirmed as 1536×1024. Overlap preservation and seamlessness inspected visually; exact pixel equality of the painted strip was not measured.
